# Visahouse

> Every visa under one roof. Online visa guidance, document checklists, Schengen appointment help, and travel insurance for Pakistani passport holders. Operated by AMG (https://amgvisa.com).

- Last Updated: 2026-11-27
- Brand & Alternate Names: Visahouse, AMG Visa, Visahouse Pakistan
- Operator: Visahouse (visahouse.online) — online-first visa consultancy desk affiliated with the AMG Visa network (amgvisa.com)
- Service Desks: Islamabad · Lahore · Karachi (Online Desk across Pakistan)
- Service Scope: Private administrative visitor, business, and tourist visa filing support (not a government embassy or regulated legal representative)
- Website: https://visahouse.online
- Full Structured Knowledge Base: https://visahouse.online/llms-full.txt
- WhatsApp / Phone: +92 331 8877655
- Email: info@visahouse.online
- Office Hours: Monday to Saturday, 10:00 – 19:00 PKT
- Disclaimer: Visahouse is a private consultancy, not a government body or embassy. Final decisions rest with the authorities.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://visahouse.online/): Overview, document checklist builder, visa cost calculator, photo guide, and visa status tracker
- [All Visa Guides](https://visahouse.online/visas): Directory of 42 country visa guides from Pakistan
- [Schengen Appointments](https://visahouse.online/schengen-appointments): Official VFS Global & BLS International guidance from Islamabad, Lahore, and Karachi
- [Travel Insurance](https://visahouse.online/travel-insurance): Schengen-accepted (€30,000+ medical) and worldwide travel insurance plans
- [About Visahouse](https://visahouse.online/about): Scope of practice, operator disclosure, and how our online visa desk works
- [Contact](https://visahouse.online/contact): WhatsApp and email inquiry desk plus payment safety notice
